{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check that parsing worked
print(f"After parsing, revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample of parsed revenue: {df['revenue'].sample(5).values}")

# Confirm no QA orders (999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders after parsing: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Confirm status values
print(f"Unique status values: {df['status'].unique()}")"}
